blurb: Daniel Cooney Fine Art is a contemporary art gallery in New York City specializing in photographs and illustration. We opened our first office in Williamsburg, Brooklyn in August, 2003 and in June of 2004 we relocated to the Chelsea District of Manhattan. Our goal is to exhibit emerging and under recognized artists and to further the career of the select group of artists that we represent.
